## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The missing-results path must be fixed before merge because it permits release without saved checks. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a missing-file fallback for saved results and loads optional display preferences with a default light theme. It adds tests for saved check outcomes and preference loading.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Fail closed when release results are missing — When the results file does not exist, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True` instead of raising `FileNotFoundError`. Returning `[]` feeds `all(...)` at line 12, which accepts an empty iterable. — A missing or misconfigured results file lets callers authorize a release without evidence that any checks passed.
